figures.caption: Figure 3: Variance reduction via the Δ-MRDR objective in a highly heterogeneous environment. The Δ𝛽★-IPS estimator serves as the optimal model-free baseline. The Δ-DR estimator minimises global MSE, causing it to overfit to the noisy majority and mischaracterise the baseline for the target group, resulting in suboptimal variance. The Δ-MRDR estimator targets model capacity exclusively at the regions of high policy divergence, learning the correct local relationship and significantly reducing ATE estimation variance.
